title: Really nice tumbler, great for the gym or in the car!
text: Really nice tumbler, great for the gym or in the car!. This is a great tumbler. I live in a golf cart community in Florida and I love to have a 'beverage' when I am driving around. This tumbler is well made and does not leak no matter how much the cart bounces. It is easy to clean, I just open it up and put it in the dishwasher top and all. I love the dark blue color as well as it blends with my cart as well. Whether I want something cold or hot, this tumbler maintains the temperature of the liquid well. Highly recommend for anyone!

product_metadata.title: VeeFine Coffee Tumbler 20oz (Black, 20oz)
features: ERGONOMIC DESIGN: After investigating and testing seventeen travel coffee mugs already exist on the market, we found that most dents and scald cases are caused by accidentally falling from hand. VeeFine redesigned tumbler with unique appearance, which combines ergonomics and beauty to grab it way much more steady, easier and safer than market standard.

TEMPERATURE SHIELD: Double-wall insulated tumbler especially designed to keep icy cold or pipping hot, which maintain your favorite beverage in best flavor for a long time, enjoy this great season with VeeFine travel coffee mug.

TOP MATERIAL: 18/8 food-grade stainless steel is extra sturdy and rustproof, which prevents dents caused by falling damage or rust. Powder coating feels smooth in hands, meanwhile no more tiny drops of condensation to wet your hands or car seats.

FOOD GRADE SAFETY: Sliding lid made by BPA-Free Tritan material, a safer material for human health compared with common PP plastic on market, which keeps people far away from potential chemical threat during hydration.

DISHWASHER SAFE: Tired of cleaning coffee remains? No more mess to clear up with VeeFine dishwasher safe travel coffee mug, just put it into the top rack then turn your dishwasher on to save ten more minutes with the one you love.
